questions_options_check.name: questions_options_check
questions_options_check.value:
case when jsonb_typeof("questions"."options") = 'array'
                then jsonb_array_length("questions"."options") = 4
                 and jsonb_array_length("questions"."options" - '') = 4
                else false
           end

questions_distractor_misconceptions_chec.name: questions_distractor_misconceptions_check
questions_distractor_misconceptions_chec.value:
case
            when "questions"."distractor_misconceptions" is null then true
            when jsonb_typeof("questions"."distractor_misconceptions") <> 'object' then false
            else jsonb_array_length(
                   jsonb_path_query_array("questions"."distractor_misconceptions", '$.keyvalue()')
                 ) = 3
                 and "questions"."distractor_misconceptions" - array['0', '1', '2', '3'] = '{}'::jsonb
                 and not ("questions"."distractor_misconceptions" ? ("questions"."correct_index")::text)
          end

generated.as:
case when language = 'hi'
            then setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(chapter_title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(topic, '') || ' ' || coalesce(concept, '')), 'A')
              || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(chunk_text, '')), 'B')
            else setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(chapter_title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(topic, '') || ' ' || coalesce(concept, '')), 'A')
              || setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(chunk_text, '')), 'B')
          end

practice_responses_answer_changed_check.name: practice_responses_answer_changed_check
practice_responses_answer_changed_check.value:
"practice_responses"."first_selected_index" is null
          or "practice_responses"."answer_changed" is null
          or "practice_responses"."answer_changed" = ("practice_responses"."first_selected_index" <> "practice_responses"."selected_index")

practice_sessions_submitted_complete_che.name: practice_sessions_submitted_complete_check
practice_sessions_submitted_complete_che.value:
"practice_sessions"."submitted_at" is null
          or ("practice_sessions"."score_percent" is not null
              and "practice_sessions"."xp_earned" is not null
              and "practice_sessions"."is_valid" is not null)

practice_sessions_invalid_reason_check.name: practice_sessions_invalid_reason_check
practice_sessions_invalid_reason_check.value:
("practice_sessions"."is_valid" is not false or "practice_sessions"."invalid_reason" is not null)
          and ("practice_sessions"."is_valid" is not true or "practice_sessions"."invalid_reason" is null)

chat_messages_citations_array_check.name: chat_messages_citations_array_check
chat_messages_citations_array_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("chat_messages"."citations") = 'array' then true else false end

retrieval_traces_retrieved_array_check.name: retrieval_traces_retrieved_array_check
retrieval_traces_retrieved_array_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("retrieval_traces"."retrieved") = 'array' then true else false end

retrieval_traces_citations_array_check.name: retrieval_traces_citations_array_check
retrieval_traces_citations_array_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("retrieval_traces"."citations") = 'array' then true else false end

subscriptions_payer_exactly_one_check.name: subscriptions_payer_exactly_one_check
subscriptions_payer_exactly_one_check.value:
("subscriptions"."payer_kind" = 'user' and "subscriptions"."payer_user_id" is not null and "subscriptions"."payer_school_id" is null)
          or ("subscriptions"."payer_kind" = 'school' and "subscriptions"."payer_school_id" is not null and "subscriptions"."payer_user_id" is null)

subscriptions_terminal_period_check.name: subscriptions_terminal_period_check
subscriptions_terminal_period_check.value: "subscriptions"."status" not in ('cancelled', 'expired') or "subscriptions"."current_period_end" is not null

notifications_bilingual_check.name: notifications_bilingual_check
notifications_bilingual_check.value:
length(btrim("notifications"."title_en")) > 0
          and length(btrim("notifications"."body_en")) > 0
          and length(btrim("notifications"."title_hi")) > 0
          and length(btrim("notifications"."body_hi")) > 0
